purpose: Read-only live PostgREST union grammar, exact-count completeness, ID-set equivalence and bounded end-to-end API cost diagnostic
role: anonymous publishable key; no user session, service secret or direct SQL
cases: two deterministically selected approved restaurant name/address pairs
output: only status, count, request counts, equal-ID-set booleans and elapsed milliseconds
timeResolution: performance.now; API wall includes network and client overhead; not server query time
